title: Rate limits shared through Redis
prompt: The app will run on several servers that share a Redis. When the REDIS_URL environment variable is set, connect to it with the redis package (add REDIS_URL to the app's config as an optional secret) and keep route rate limit counts in Redis, and make GET /ready check Redis too. Without REDIS_URL, keep the default in-memory rate limits. Use Inferlo's built-in Redis support; do not write your own rate limiter.
